content.title: Social Interface Prank | Screen Exit, Tile Cleanup and Written Payoff
content.summary: An adult lab host exits a feed window, clears its content and writes TEST COMPLETE. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity persists inside and outside the interface. + The transition crosses one visible screen boundary exactly once. + Digital content becomes countable physical pieces before removal. + The writing area is visibly cleared before any new text appears. + The final exact phrase and the responsible character remain together.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one original adult lab host tasting one red berry inside a circular research-feed video window. He reads one displayed note, pulls its text tiles off as white paper squares and drops them into one tray. Write the exact phrase TEST COMPLETE in white by hand, cap the marker and end with the adult host smiling beside the readable result.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity persists inside and outside the interface.
The transition crosses one visible screen boundary exactly once.
The writing area is visibly cleared before any new text appears.
The final exact phrase and the responsible character remain together.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult lab host exits a feed window, clears its content and writes TEST COMPLETE. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先把成年人物限制在圆形社交视频窗内完成普通动作，再让同一人物走出屏幕边界、用实体工具清除页面内容并直接在空白界面写下结果；终局回到人物与手写字同框。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity persists inside and outside the interface.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity persists inside and outside the interface."

invariants.rule: The transition crosses one visible screen boundary exactly once.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The transition crosses one visible screen boundary exactly once."

invariants.rule: Digital content becomes countable physical pieces before removal.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Digital content becomes countable physical pieces before removal."

invariants.rule: The writing area is visibly cleared before any new text appears.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The writing area is visibly cleared before any new text appears."

invariants.rule: The final exact phrase and the responsible character remain together.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final exact phrase and the responsible character remain together."
